title: UPDATE! Fresh Month, Fresh Start! VibeToplist Rankings Reset Tonight!
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
I am completely aware that i've been posting here quite a bit lately, so I'll keep this one short.

In just a couple of hours, VibeToplist's monthly leaderboard resets for November, meaning every game gets a fresh opportunity to climb the rankings. The ranking leaderboard automatically resets every 1st of the month.

We're also approaching 400 game submissions, which is honestly crazy on top of the organic traffic growth we have had the past couple months. We are blessed to be the #1 AI-Assisted & Vibe Coded game discovery platform. Thank you everyone for contributing!

If you've been thinking about submitting your AI-assisted game, now's a great time to join.

Thanks again to everyone here who's been part of the journey. Really appreciate this community, and feel free to share your project also within the comment section, I am up to play some new expirements tonight.

See you all in November!

[https://vibetoplist.com/](https://vibetoplist.com/)
